system.description:
A disciplined two-handed weapon specialist, from any army or arena that values the big swing. You don't parry; you end fights.

  • Crushing Blow: reroll 1s and 2s on the damage dice of two-handed weapons.
    • 9th level: once per round, when you hit with a two-handed weapon, a creature of your size or smaller makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is pushed 5ft.
  • Breaker: Advantage on Strength checks to break, smash or force objects.
